A '''thin creature''' was used as a pet during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was a four-legged creature with a thin waist, protruding ribs, dainty feet with only one toe, and a long nose.<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

A [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] New Republic [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] had one of these creatures as a pet.<ref name="Wildlife" />

==Behind the scenes==
The creature appeared in [[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide|''The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide'']]'','' written by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] and [[Bob Carrau]] and illustrated by Terryl Whitlatch, in the "Senators and their Menageries" section of the book. 

It isn't named in the book, nor is there an entry about it; not even its [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of origin is known.<ref name="Wildlife" />{{Creature-stub}}
